customers_org_document_unique.name: customers_org_document_unique
customers_org_document_unique.where: document is not null and deleted_at is null

vehicles_org_plate_unique.name: vehicles_org_plate_unique
vehicles_org_plate_unique.where: plate_canonical is not null and deleted_at is null

suppliers_org_document_unique.name: suppliers_org_document_unique
suppliers_org_document_unique.where: document is not null and deleted_at is null

parts_org_sku_unique.name: parts_org_sku_unique
parts_org_sku_unique.where: sku is not null and deleted_at is null

attachments_parent_check.name: attachments_parent_check
attachments_parent_check.value: "attachments"."work_order_id" is not null or "attachments"."inspection_id" is not null or "attachments"."vehicle_id" is not null

work_order_items_service_has_no_part_che.name: work_order_items_service_has_no_part_check
work_order_items_service_has_no_part_che.value: ("work_order_items"."type" = 'SERVICE' and "work_order_items"."part_id" is null) or ("work_order_items"."type" = 'PART' and "work_order_items"."service_id" is null)

work_orders_cancel_reason_check.name: work_orders_cancel_reason_check
work_orders_cancel_reason_check.value: "work_orders"."canceled_at" is null or "work_orders"."cancel_reason" is not null

quote_approvals_proof_check.name: quote_approvals_proof_check
quote_approvals_proof_check.value: ("quote_approvals"."channel" = 'PUBLIC_LINK' and "quote_approvals"."signer_name" is not null) or ("quote_approvals"."channel" <> 'PUBLIC_LINK' and "quote_approvals"."recorded_by_user_id" is not null)

payments_cancel_reason_check.name: payments_cancel_reason_check
payments_cancel_reason_check.value: "payments"."canceled_at" is null or "payments"."cancel_reason" is not null

appointments_cancel_reason_check.name: appointments_cancel_reason_check
appointments_cancel_reason_check.value: "appointments"."canceled_at" is null or "appointments"."cancel_reason" is not null

supplier_quote_requests_cancel_reason_ch.name: supplier_quote_requests_cancel_reason_check
supplier_quote_requests_cancel_reason_ch.value: "supplier_quote_requests"."canceled_at" is null or "supplier_quote_requests"."cancel_reason" is not null

supplier_quote_response_items_price_chec.name: supplier_quote_response_items_price_check
supplier_quote_response_items_price_chec.value:
("supplier_quote_response_items"."availability" = 'UNAVAILABLE' and "supplier_quote_response_items"."unit_price_cents" is null)
          or ("supplier_quote_response_items"."availability" <> 'UNAVAILABLE' and "supplier_quote_response_items"."unit_price_cents" is not null and "supplier_quote_response_items"."unit_price_cents" > 0)

purchase_orders_canceled_check.name: purchase_orders_canceled_check
purchase_orders_canceled_check.value: ("purchase_orders"."status" = 'CANCELED') = ("purchase_orders"."canceled_at" is not null) and ("purchase_orders"."canceled_at" is null or "purchase_orders"."cancel_reason" is not null)

purchase_orders_close_reason_check.name: purchase_orders_close_reason_check
purchase_orders_close_reason_check.value: "purchase_orders"."closed_short_at" is null or "purchase_orders"."close_reason" is not null

financial_entries_origin_document_check.name: financial_entries_origin_document_check
financial_entries_origin_document_check.value: ("financial_entries"."origin" <> 'WORK_ORDER' or "financial_entries"."work_order_id" is not null) and ("financial_entries"."origin" <> 'PURCHASE' or "financial_entries"."purchase_order_id" is not null)

financial_entries_canceled_check.name: financial_entries_canceled_check
financial_entries_canceled_check.value: ("financial_entries"."status" = 'CANCELED') = ("financial_entries"."canceled_at" is not null) and ("financial_entries"."canceled_at" is null or "financial_entries"."cancel_reason" is not null)

financial_settlements_canceled_check.name: financial_settlements_canceled_check
financial_settlements_canceled_check.value: ("financial_settlements"."status" = 'CANCELED') = ("financial_settlements"."canceled_at" is not null) and ("financial_settlements"."canceled_at" is null or "financial_settlements"."cancel_reason" is not null)

work_order_item_timers_stopped_check.name: work_order_item_timers_stopped_check
work_order_item_timers_stopped_check.value: ("work_order_item_timers"."stopped_at" is null) = ("work_order_item_timers"."minutes" is null) and ("work_order_item_timers"."stopped_at" is null or "work_order_item_timers"."stopped_at" >= "work_order_item_timers"."started_at")
